findings.title: Reuse HttpClient across notifications.
findings.rationale:
NotifyAsync creates and disposes a HttpClient for every request. Under load, this prevents connection reuse and can exhaust sockets or ephemeral ports.

Inject a long-lived HttpClient, or use IHttpClientFactory. Configure BaseAddress once.
